name: Plaquemines Parish, Louisiana (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, golden yellow and blue for courage, honour and piety, with a green triangle at the hoist bordered in white for the growth of the delta.
history: Plaquemines Parish is a parish located in Louisiana. The flag was adopted on 14 June 1978 (designed by a resident, E. Montgomery, in a parish-wide contest and raised for the first time over the Judge L. H. Perez Memorial Park on 14 June 1978, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: triangle bordered in white for the delta
